about: Hamilton Township is a township in Northumberland County, Ontario, surrounding Cobourg on Lake Ontario—not the City of Hamilton. Rural hamlets, farmland, and Rice Lake approaches share countryside north of the lakeshore town. About 11,000 people live in Hamilton Township.
seoSummary: Northumberland County township around Cobourg—farmland and Rice Lake approaches, not the City of Hamilton.
